records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During both the 2021 third quarter and first nine months, approximately 65% of marine transportation’s inland revenues were under term contracts and 35% were spot contract revenues.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consequently, the Company’s marine transportation business is directly affected by the volumes produced by the Company’s petroleum, petrochemical and refining customer base.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The net result was a decrease of 30 inland tank barges and approximately 907,000 barrels of capacity.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decreases for the 2021 first nine months were primarily due to reduced barge utilization in the inland and coastal markets as well as reduced term and spot pricing in the inland market when compared to 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities for the 2021 first nine months decreased primarily due to lower revenues and operating income in the marine transportation segment, partially offset by the receipt of a tax refund of $119,493,000, including accrued interest, for the Company’s 2019 federal tax return.
